meta.title: Sectioned Feature Development
meta.description: Orchestrates sectioned feature development: cleanup and branch gating, plan review accounting, ES actor dispatch, wave budgets, advisor escalation, and side-panel progress.

cleanup.dirtyQuestion: The workspace has uncommitted changes. How should SFD proceed?
cleanup.onMain: On main. A feature branch will be created.
cleanup.branchNameQuestion: Confirm the feature branch name (from the feature slug):
cleanup.sameBehind: main is strictly behind this branch (ahead>0, behind=0).
cleanup.sameAhead: main is strictly ahead of this branch (ahead=0, behind>0).
cleanup.diverged: This branch and main have diverged (ahead>0, behind>0).
cleanup.inSync: This branch is in sync with main (ahead=0, behind=0).
cleanup.newFromCurrent: New branch from the current branch
cleanup.ffToCurrent: Fast-forward main to this branch first

state.notGit: The working directory is not a Git repository.
state.esMissing: external-subagent is required but not detected. Install it first: brew install external-subagent (or see its README), then run `external-subagent agents enable zcode codex`.
state.esProfileMissing: Required external-subagent profile(s) missing: {names}. Create them or use the panel's profile installer.
state.resume: Existing SFD state detected — resuming handoff briefing follows.
state.fresh: No SFD state found — starting a fresh run from the Git cleanup gate.
